title: Deliver linked screen and diagram editing
summary: Deliver the complete product journey: open repository-backed design truth, place screens and diagram objects, select and transform them, connect flows, inspect source context, and save.
acceptance_criteria: Implement the complete flagship journey: open repository-backed design truth, place screens and diagram objects, select and transform them, connect flows, inspect source context, and save.
Document the user's starting context, job, expected value, success, and safe-abort outcome.
Provide one clear entry point and preserve context through navigation, restart, or interruption.
Design loading, empty, stale, offline, permission-denied, partial, error, retry, and recovery states.
Use repository-owned design tokens, components, interaction patterns, and content style.
Remove ambiguous actions, duplicate calls to action, and hidden state changes.
Support keyboard or alternative input where relevant.
Support semantic accessibility, focus, scaling or Dynamic Type, contrast, and reduced motion.
Provide equivalent localized meaning and correct dynamic formatting for every declared locale.
Keep performance within measured budgets for launch and critical interactions.
Preserve user work during refresh, navigation, backgrounding, and failure.
Make destructive, financial, hardware, publication, or privacy-sensitive actions previewable and confirmable.
Provide privacy-safe diagnostics and explicit feedback mechanisms.
Apply monetization posture `internal-now-optional-commercialization-later` without dark patterns or irrelevant revenue pressure.
Keep optional agent assistance transparent, reversible, and unnecessary for core value.
Add behavior tests for normal, failure, and recovery paths.
Add visual or runtime evidence for the critical states, not only the happy path.
Run an accessibility and localization review before closing.
Record the before-and-after user experience and known limitations.
Avoid unrelated architecture rewrites.
Finish with zero app-owned warnings.
